GET STARTED

Your first steps.

Understand the project first, then review compatibility, releases, and community support.

Know who you are dealing with

GTA V iOS Community is an independent fan community. It is not Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, or Apple. This site never asks for account passwords, two-factor codes, signing certificates, private keys, or authentication tokens.

STEP 01 / 05PROJECT IDENTITY

Start with the project overview.

This community follows development of an independent GTA V project for supported Apple devices. Public pages provide information and support. They do not represent Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, or Apple.

RECOMMENDED READINGRead the project FAQ

Use legitimate game files

The website does not provide Rockstar game data. Use only files you obtained lawfully.

STEP 02 / 05COMPATIBILITY

Check your device.

Review your exact model, RAM, storage, and OS information before relying on community reports. The checker provides planning guidance rather than a guarantee.

DEVICE INFORMATIONCheck compatibility

Hardware limits still apply

No website setting can increase physical RAM or guarantee performance on an unsupported device.

STEP 03 / 05SAFETY & SUPPORT

Read the project guide.

The guide covers backups, legitimate game files, release verification, and safe support practices without asking for private credentials.

RECOMMENDED READINGRead the guide

Keep credentials private

Never send passwords, two-factor codes, certificates, private keys, or account tokens to community members.

STEP 04 / 05RELEASE HISTORY

Know what changed.

Review the latest release notes, known issues, and supported platforms before changing a working setup.

PROJECT HISTORYRead release notes

Verify the release context

Confirm the build name and date before following community-specific advice.

STEP 05 / 05COMMUNITY

Continue with the community.

Use the community page for discussion, support, and current project information. Verify identities before sharing files or following account-related instructions.

COMMUNITY SUPPORTOpen community

Report suspicious requests

If anyone asks for passwords, authentication codes, certificates, private keys, or payment while claiming to represent this site, do not comply.

Move at your own pace. Each step links to public information on this site.
